title: Why we focus on brakes, suspension and tyres
summary: We keep our work focused so we can do it well. Here is what that means when you call.
image_alt: Illustration of the Kestrel Garage workshop
author: The Kestrel Garage team

body.p: Kestrel Garage concentrates on brakes, suspension, steering, tyres and routine servicing.
We do not offer bodywork, paintwork or welding. If you are not sure whether we can help, call the front desk and ask.
